policy: deterministic shape-tier pruning, not a learned scorer
steps: 1. classify shape from QueryIntent + retrieval state
2. per-shape: keep mandatory + shape-required evidence, drop optional (body_range on exact/ambiguous, related on exact, connector on non-paths)
4. enforce serialized-byte budget by dropping lowest-priority optional records (related -> extra seeds -> ranges)
complementary_bundles: relationship endpoints + via kept together; connector steps kept together
